sloka: इत्येवं घोषयन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः ।अभ्यधावन्त लङ्कायाः प्राकारं कामरूपिणः ।। ६.४२.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: ityevaṁ ghoṣayantaśca garjantaśca plavaṅgamāḥ ।abhyadhāvanta laṅkāyāḥ prākāraṁ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।। 6.42.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Shouting in that manner, the monkeys who could change their form at their will started roaring and rushed towards the defensive walls.
